title: Spotting the NSA by where number theory PhDs cluster around Fort Meade
place_text: Fort Meade, Maryland; Los Alamos, New Mexico

tellings.quote: you'd look at number theory PhDs and you'd ask what zip codes do number theory PhDs live in when they don't get an academic job that's visible and you find that they're clustered around Fort me.

plain: A mathematician named Eric Weinstein, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, describes a way to find hidden government work. He says you could look at people with doctorates in number theory, a branch of mathematics used in code-making, who never got a visible university job, and check where they live. He says they turn out to cluster around Fort Meade, Maryland, home of the NSA, the US code-breaking agency, which he offers as a way secret programmes give themselves away.
